page.overview:
Who is Brom Goldhand?

Arbiter Brom Goldhand is a human member of the Tal'Dorei Council, the former captain of the guard, the Master of Law, and the head of the Watchful Hall. As an NPC, Brom is played by Matthew Mercer.

In 810 PD, Brom is a built and armored man, the tallest of the Tal'Dorei Council. He has a thick square jaw that is unshaven with short black hair. He suffered extensive burn scars from the Chroma Conclave's attack on Emon.

By 836 PD, Brom's hair has turned gray and he maintains a stoic lack of expression.

Brom Goldhand took up his position in the Tal'Dorei Council three months before he met Vox Machina. The position had previously been held by General Krieg.
